name: Cooling eye mask
lead: A cooling eye mask is a gel pad or packet, chilled in a fridge or freezer, that is placed over the eyes. It is used in the morning to reduce temporary puffiness around the eyes.
The effect is short-lived and cosmetic. No peer-reviewed trial of these masks was found; guidance from eye-care and consumer health sources supports cold compresses for transient swelling.

paras: Cold causes vasoconstriction and slows fluid accumulation, so eyelids look less swollen after several minutes. Gentle pressure from the pad may help too.

Applying ice directly to eyelids can injure skin, so a barrier and short use are advised. Persistent, one-sided, painful or vision-affecting swelling needs medical review, as it may indicate infection or other disease. It does not treat eye bags that are structural or fat-related.
